title: test(runtime,metadata-protocol,objectql): pay the lint root's first load at module top where a clocked case paid it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9paTx1Lu8ENYwwssthfK3h)_
Fixes #29627

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改测试。三个包各加一个测试专用的预载模块(`lint-root-preload.testkit.ts`)，在模块顶部加载 `@objectstack/lint` 包根；实测会在用例里冷加载它的 66 个测试文件(runtime 9、metadata-protocol 39、objectql 18)在文件顶部各引入一行。objectql 另加 lint 的 devDependency 和锚定源码别名。
- 为什么改：第一次读视图或发布对象时，协议层才懒加载 lint 包根，vitest 下这次冷编译落在某个计时用例里：metadata-protocol 和 objectql 的这类用例空闲时约 0.7–0.8 秒，四路并发下最慢 2.3 秒，而 5 秒超时是同一个用例的预算，分片负载一高就可能超时变红。现在这笔开销在收集阶段付掉，这些用例降到几十毫秒。
- 风险与回滚：不动产品代码，不加超时，不重试，不跳过，断言一条没改。回滚即还原本 PR。唯一越出测试文件的是 objectql 的 `package.json`/`pnpm-lock.yaml` 多一条 devDependency。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/package.json` 与 `packages/objectql/vitest.config.ts`(新依赖与别名)，`packages/metadata-protocol/src/lint-root-preload.testkit.ts`(为何不用 setupFiles 的实测)，任一个测试文件顶部新增的两行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.lock-door-read-agree.test.ts --reporter=verbose`，预期全绿，`an overlay view declaring _lock=none` 那个用例约 45 毫秒(main 上约 0.8 秒)。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **One preload testkit per package**: `packages/runtime/src/lint-root-preload.testkit.ts`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/lint-root-preload.testkit.ts`, `packages/objectql/src/__fixtures__/lint-root-preload.testkit.ts`. Each is a module-top `import '@objectstack/lint'` with a header naming the cost it moves and why it is not a setup file.
- **66 test files** import their package's testkit at module top (two lines each: a one-line comment and the import): runtime 9, metadata-protocol 39, objectql 18. Each is a file whose traced run paid the lint root's first load inside a case. No `it`, `expect`, timeout or helper changes.
- **objectql**: `@objectstack/lint` becomes a devDependency (`package.json`, 3 lines in `pnpm-lock.yaml`), and `vitest.config.ts` gains the anchored `^@objectstack/lint$` alias to `../lint/src/index.ts`. Both are forced, see Acceptance notes.
- **runtime** `vitest.config.ts`: one comment on the existing `#29603` alias now names the testkit. No resolution change.

## Why

A served view read wraps its body in `withFormLayoutWarnings`, which awaits `loadFormLayoutLint()` (`import('@objectstack/lint')`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/metadata-diagnostics.ts`). An object publish's build probes load the same root the same way (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/build-probes.ts`). Under vitest the first such load in a file is a cold transform of the lint graph, inside whichever case gets there first. A module-top import is paid during collection, which no timeout clocks, and the protocol's later `import()` gets the same instance back. The lazy import itself is product design and stays as it is.

### How the population was measured

Not by grep. A scratch tracer (deleted) appended one counter increment to the lint root's transformed module and recorded, per test file, whether the counter moved during collection, in a hook, or inside a case. One run of each package's whole suite (both vitest projects) on `7dae3b3c0d`:

| package | files | load inside a case | at module top already | elsewhere |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| runtime | 532 | 9 | 1 (`meta-write-org-scope.test.ts`) | 0 |
| metadata-protocol | 308 | 39 | 4 | 1, in a describe-level `beforeAll` with a 120000 ms budget (`protocol.read-lock-flags-write-door.test.ts`), dropped |
| objectql | 544 | 18 | 0 | 0 |

The card's coarse grep (real protocol plus a view read, minus files already importing the root) names 149 files in the three packages. The trace keeps 43 of them and drops 106, and it finds 23 positives the grep misses, mostly object publishes reaching the build probes. Of the card's three named runtime candidates, `package-revert-stored-members` and `meta-save-preconditions-parity` are kept; `packages-seed-apply-org-scope` is dropped (the lint root is never evaluated in that file).

### Measurements

Each sample is one vitest process on one file (`--maxWorkers=1`, json reporter), under `os-verify-lock.sh` on a 4-vCPU shared box. "Idle" is 3 sequential runs. "4x" is the contention method from #29622: 4 identical copies of the same file run concurrently, 1 round, 4 samples. The number is the duration of the case the trace named. Before is `7dae3b3c0d`; after is `4bab1b183f` (the same base plus this change). 0 failed runs in 924 samples.

| package | before idle p50 / max | before 4x p50 / max | after idle p50 / max | after 4x p50 / max |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| runtime (9 files) | 237 / 542 | 436 / 920 | 119 / 384 | 118 / 408 |
| metadata-protocol (39) | 714 / 838 | 975 / 1241 | 25 / 65 | 29 / 88 |
| objectql (18) | 796 / 1139 | 1169 / 2282 | 108 / 231 | 139 / 347 |

In runtime the root already resolves to lint's source through #29622's alias, and that load is cheaper (roughly 100 to 300 ms) than the 1.5 MB `dist/` bundle metadata-protocol and objectql read (roughly 650 to 1100 ms). It still lands in the case, so the 9 files are kept. After the change, a targeted re-trace of the 66 files shows the root evaluated once per file, at collection, and 0 in-case loads.

### Why a testkit per file and not one setup file

Measured first: a `setupFiles` entry in each package (commit `a89a1ccea2`, superseded) did warm every case, but it made every file in the package pay the lint load, including the many that never reach it. Whole-suite runs, setup plus import worker time and wall, against the traced baseline on the same base:

| package | baseline setup+import / wall | with setupFiles setup+import / wall |
|---|---|---|
| metadata-protocol | 506 s / 207 s | 707 s / 279 s |
| objectql | 772 s / 312 s | 1101 s / 433 s |
| runtime | 1561 s / 608 s | 1758 s / 689 s |

So the shared piece is the one module per package, and only the files that reach the load import it. Its header tells the author of a new file when to add the import.

## Acceptance notes

- **Deviation, objectql `package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml`.** objectql does not depend on `@objectstack/lint`; metadata-protocol does, and loads it from its `dist/`. A static import of it from objectql code fails `tsc` with TS2882 (measured: `src/__fixtures__/lint-root-preload.ts(1,8): error TS2882: Cannot find module or type declarations for side-effect import of '@objectstack/lint'`), so the import needs the package declared. A devDependency is enough because the file sits under `__fixtures__`, which `check:undeclared-dep-imports` reads as test code (a `.testkit.ts` beside product source was red there).
- **The objectql alias is forced**: removing it reds `check:test-source-alias` with `@objectstack/objectql: NEW unaliased artifact import(s) ... @objectstack/lint`. With it, the preload and metadata-protocol's own `import()` resolve to one source module.
- **The object-publish path is included.** The card names the view read; the build probes load the same root on an object publish, and 23 of the 66 files reach it only that way. Same cost, same fix.
- **PM assumption 1, partly held**: runtime's #29622 alias does make the cold load a source-graph transform, and it is about a third of the `dist/` cost, but it still sits in 9 runtime cases. **PM assumption 2, refuted**: metadata-protocol resolves the root to `dist/` (no alias; its `check:test-source-alias` row lists it).
- **No gate arm.** `check:test-source-alias` is static, and this load is reached at run time through another package's code: whether a case's read serves a `view` record, or a publish includes an object, is data. A dependency-shaped arm (any package whose tests import the protocol must preload) would name about 40 packages beyond these three, most of them never reaching the load, and red untouched packages. The tracer above is the instrument that answers the question; it is a scratch tool and is not landed.
- Not measured: packages outside runtime, metadata-protocol and objectql whose tests boot the real protocol.
- No timeout, retry, skip or assertion changed. Forced test edits: none.

## Verification
